scripts.build: pnpm --filter @gmassisstant/types build && pnpm --filter @gmassisstant/backend build && pnpm --filter @gmassisstant/frontend build
scripts.desktop:dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend,electron -c blue,green,yellow "pnpm --filter @gmassisstant/backend dev" "pnpm --filter @gmassisstant/frontend dev" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && cd packages/desktop && electron ."
scripts.desktop:compile: cd packages/backend && tsc && cd ../frontend && vite build --mode desktop && cd ../desktop && tsc
